description.value: Bar Burrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, proudly Canadian since 2005 with 385+ locations, offering fully customizable Mexican-inspired burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas made with fresh, in-house ingredients. The Abbotsford McCallum location is a fast-casual counter-service restaurant situated near the Trans-Canada corridor, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley. Protein options range from grilled chicken and steak to fully vegetarian and fish choices.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 9m; rack (7 spaces) at 95m. Total: 10 spaces.
